SELECT AVG(daily_reg) FROM ( SELECT s.stats_date, SUM(s.total_guahao) AS daily_reg FROM TR_OUTPATIENT_STATS_DAY_RESULT s INNER JOIN TR_DEPT_DICT d ON s.dept_code = d.dept_code WHERE s.stats_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}
GROUP BY s.stats_date )

SELECT AVG(daily_appoint) FROM ( SELECT a.appoint_date, SUM(a.appoint_count) AS daily_appoint FROM tr_fc_appoint a LEFT JOIN TR_DEPT_DICT d ON a.dept_code = d.dept_code WHERE a.appoint_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}
GROUP BY a.appoint_date )
SELECT SUM(a.appoint_count) FROM tr_fc_appoint a LEFT JOIN TR_DEPT_DICT d ON a.dept_code = d.dept_code WHERE a.appoint_date = #{appointDate}

SELECT 1 - SUM(s.tui_hao_shu + s.shuang_yue_shu) / NULLIF(SUM(s.total_guahao), 0) FROM TR_OUTPATIENT_STATS_DAY_RESULT s INNER JOIN TR_DEPT_DICT d ON s.dept_code = d.dept_code WHERE s.stats_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}
SELECT hol_date FROM tr_fc_holiday WHERE hol_type = 'LEGAL_HOLIDAY' AND hol_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ORDER BY hol_date DESC

SELECT MAX(s.stats_date) FROM TR_OUTPATIENT_STATS_DAY_RESULT s WHERE s.stats_date < #{beforeDate} AND TO_CHAR(s.stats_date, 'DY', 'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=AMERICAN') NOT IN ('SAT', 'SUN') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tr_fc_holiday h WHERE h.hol_date = s.stats_date)
SELECT NVL(SUM(s.total_guahao), 0) FROM TR_OUTPATIENT_STATS_DAY_RESULT s INNER JOIN TR_DEPT_DICT d ON s.dept_code = d.dept_code WHERE s.stats_date = #{statDate}

SELECT TO_CHAR(s.stats_date, 'MM') AS forecastMonth, SUM(s.total_guahao) AS forecastValue FROM TR_OUTPATIENT_STATS_DAY_RESULT s INNER JOIN TR_DEPT_DICT d ON s.dept_code = d.dept_code WHERE TO_CHAR(s.stats_date, 'YYYY') = #{year}
GROUP BY TO_CHAR(s.stats_date, 'MM') ORDER BY forecastMonth
SELECT NVL(SUM(s.total_guahao), 0) FROM TR_OUTPATIENT_STATS_DAY_RESULT s INNER JOIN TR_DEPT_DICT d ON s.dept_code = d.dept_code WHERE s.stats_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}
